question: Between the frozen failing independent-43 state and exact independent-44 state, is any one of the 27 marginal 44th surface records sufficient by itself to restore the antipodal pair-preserving failure law relative to the resulting arm's own full-five-coordinate membership?
hypothesis: At least one but not necessarily all of the 27 single-marginal-record arms will reproduce the independent-44 outcome: all 127 pair-preserving partitions match zero of four panels, with no partial partitions. Arms not sufficient will be retained exactly, including unchanged or regressed outcomes.

prior_evidence.lower_observation: Independent-43 produced 23 full-five-coordinate classes, one intact and eight split alias triplets, zero cross-entity collisions, 120 pair-preserving all-four matches, seven pair-preserving zero matches, no partial matches, and 120 law mismatches.
prior_evidence.upper_observation: Independent-44 produced 23 full-five-coordinate classes, one intact and eight split alias triplets, zero cross-entity collisions, zero pair-preserving all-four or partial matches, 127 pair-preserving zero matches, and zero law mismatches.

scope_statement: This changes exactly one dimension from independent-43: each arm adds the frozen 44th record from exactly one surface. It does not test combinations, record replacement, alternative order, new seeds, task learning, population transfer, natural language, or deployment.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.replication_controls: Run unchanged deterministic R33 and R31 probes and require their frozen negative and exact classifications and cardinalities before R34 output.
arms_and_inputs.base_state: The frozen deterministic R7 independent sampler at exactly 43 records for each of 27 surfaces, exactly 1161 records.
arms_and_inputs.marginal_records: Generate the frozen independent-44 state once; for each surface in entity-major then family-major order, select only sample index 43 (the 44th record), verifying that the preceding 43 records byte-match the base state.
arms_and_inputs.experimental_arms: Exactly 27 arms. Arm s is the complete independent-43 base plus only surface s's frozen 44th record, exactly 1162 records; all other surfaces remain at 43.
arms_and_inputs.partition_panel: Enumerate only the independently constructed 127 nonempty complement-normalized unions of antipodal pairs. For each arm and mask evaluate bucket-prefix0, bucket-prefix1, bucket-suffix0, and bucket-suffix1 against that arm's own full-five-coordinate membership.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, full-five-coordinate class audit, per-arm record cardinality, marginal-record identity, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Frozen deterministic independent sampler streams inherited unchanged from R6 through R33; no replacement, search, or adaptive selection.
seeds.arm_order: surface index 0 through 26, corresponding to entity 0 family 0 through entity 8 family 2.

controls: The unchanged local deterministic R33 probe must reproduce boundary43_breaks_pair_preserving_failure and its exact frozen cardinalities before R34 output.
The unchanged local deterministic R31 probe must reproduce boundary44_unbalanced_antipodal_law_exact and its exact frozen cardinalities before R34 output.
The independent-43 and independent-44 generators must have zero byte mismatch across all 1161 prefix records when compared within their surface blocks.
Each arm contains exactly 1162 records: 44 for its selected surface and 43 for every other surface; exactly one generated marginal record is added and none is removed or replaced.
The 127 masks are constructed independently as nonempty unions of antipodal pairs 1 through 7 and each arm evaluates all four frozen projections exactly once in fixed order.
Entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction and enter only arm construction and the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
R33 and R31 controls reproduce their frozen classifications and exact scientific cardinalities.
All 27 marginal records and arms satisfy frozen identity, prefix, order, and cardinality controls.

Every arm has between 9 and 27 full-five-coordinate classes, zero cross-entity collisions, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 127 masks times four projections times 36 unordered entity pairs audited.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, combination search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.single_surface_marginal_sufficient: Validity and controls pass; at least one arm has all 127 pair-preserving partitions matching zero panels and no partial partitions.
classification_rules.distributed_marginal_effect: Validity and controls pass; no single arm is sufficient, at least one arm reduces the R33 baseline of 120 all-four matches, and no partition is partial.
classification_rules.no_single_surface_effect: Validity and controls pass; all 27 arms exactly retain 120 all-four matches, zero partial matches, and seven zero matches.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding scientific rules applies, including any regressed or partial outcome.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R33, R31, prefix, marginal identity, arm construction, mask construction, or cardinality control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents completion of all 27 fixed arms and 13716 panels.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, exclusivity, cardinality, projection, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on identity, R33 replication, R31 replication, prefix identity, marginal extraction, arm construction, mask construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R34 output begins, complete all 27 arms and 13716 panels unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not alter arms, marginal records, masks, formulas, controls, metrics, thresholds, capacity, budgets, or classification after observing R34 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No record, arm, mask, projection, budget, sampler stream, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R34 output.
